title: Steel plate smelted at the The Experiment workshop from all of the pilot's own stored iron ore in one visit, kept in its storage there for the reserve; open to a ship of any role
note: 2026-11-17 23:41 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-052 block MERCURY and requests.log ENT-256: a trader without a paying trade smelts its own stored iron into steel plate, then crafts from its own stored copper; rules F23, F24, F30). The craft list asks the same recipe in halving sizes; the runner quotes each entry and makes nothing where the pilot's storage does not hold that entry's inputs ('no inputs', the run goes on), so one visit uses up the pilot's own stores at this station whatever they are, where a fixed `runs` either fails or leaves the rest for a visit 40 minutes later. Nothing is bought or sold. basic_iron_smelting makes 1 steel plate from 10 iron ore, 0 cr, 0.225 ticks a run (a trader's quote at Node Beta, 23:39 UTC). The reserve still asks 31,999 steel plate to be made (the tool stock, view=reserve, 23:32 UTC). 38 traders store 8,623 iron ore at The Experiment, 74 to 488 a pilot (table holdings, 23:33 UTC): 63 runs at most a visit. A test: one ship, no lift_to, until its first RESULT line is read (rule F8). 2026-11-17 23:44 UTC (Mercury): first RESULT line read: craft-steel-own-node-beta, one trader at Node Beta, 2/2 stops in 1.7 minutes, 0 cr: the 32-run entry found too little iron, 16 and 4 runs made, 20 steel plate in all from the pilot's stores; the notes 'no inputs' are the entries that found too little, as written. The halving list works: max_ships 1 -> 10, sized by the traders that store the input here (table holdings, 23:33 UTC); no lift_to (the stores, not a field, bound it). 2026-11-23 00:16 UTC (Mercury): min 100 -> 20 iron ore (2 runs of basic_iron_smelting), so the traders that store a small stack here smelt it docked before the jump loop takes them (orders ENT-068 block MERCURY; steel plate open in the reserve: pull.py levels 23:38 UTC, held 53,681 of min 49,243, max 54,714; iron ore FULL at 146,163 of max 80,000). max_ships 6.
